d:
Brazil's Supreme Court orders a probe into the alleged foreign funding of Flavio Bolsonaro's election campaign. This comes after the right-wing leader was defeated in Sunday's election. Bolsonaro has yet to concede defeat. He has promised to legally challenge President Lula's Victory. Hem Kaur Saroya explains on Vantage.
